extension.description: A small client for rutube.ru built on its public API. Search with history, browse categories, open an uploader's channel from the context menu. Plays HLS through InputStream Adaptive when it is installed.
Небольшой клиент rutube.ru на публичном API. Поиск с историей, категории, канал автора из контекстного меню. Воспроизведение HLS через InputStream Adaptive, если он установлен.
extension.disclaimer: Not affiliated with RUTUBE. Content is streamed from rutube.ru.
